items.source: Enable AspectJ weaving with the given LoadTimeWeaver.
items.translation: 使用给定的LoadTimeWeaver启用 AspectJ 织入。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method. Invoked after ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext(..).
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet() 或自定义 init-method）之前被调用。在 ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext(..) 之后被调用。

items.source: NOTE: This method will only be called if there actually is a LoadTimeWeaver available in the application context. If there is none, the method will simply not get invoked, assuming that the implementing object is able to activate its weaving dependency accordingly.
items.translation: 注意： 如果应用程序上下文中实际上没有可用的LoadTimeWeaver，则不会调用此方法。假设实现对象能够相应地激活其织入依赖项，因此如果没有LoadTimeWeaver，该方法将不会被调用。

items.source: Set the LoadTimeWeaver of this object's containing ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 设置此对象包含的 ApplicationContext 的 LoadTimeWeaver。

items.source: Post-processor that registers AspectJ's ClassPreProcessorAgentAdapter with the Spring application context's default LoadTimeWeaver.
items.translation: 注册 AspectJ 的 ClassPreProcessorAgentAdapter 与 Spring 应用程序上下文的默认 LoadTimeWeaver 的后处理器。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

initialization.

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean factory after its standard
initialization. All bean definitions will have been loaded, but no beans
will have been instantiated yet. This allows for overriding or adding
properties even to eager-initializing beans.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文内部的 Bean 工厂。此时所有 Bean 定义都已被加载，但尚未实例化任何 Bean。这允许您甚至对急切初始化的 Bean 进行属性覆盖或添加。
